title: From Kinetic Energy Relativity to Potential Energy Relativity
content: This paper establishes the \textit{LL equation}---a novel relativistic quantum mechanical framework rigorously derived from first principles of energy conservation and energy equivalence. By introducing the renormalized mass field Meff = m0 \sqrt{1 + 2V/(m0c2)} with quantum gravity cutoff and gradient correction δH = ihc/2βα, we resolve the non-covariant potential coupling problem inherent in the Dirac equation. Theoretical consistency (probability conservation, Lorentz covariance, and classical correspondence) is proven analytically. Experimental validation across 42 high-precision tests demonstrates unprecedented accuracy with mean deviation 0.28σ, outperforming Dirac (2.10σ) and Klein-Gordon (8.35σ) equations. The LL equation provides a unified framework for quantum mechanics and general relativity, with quantum gravity effects observed at 5.2σ significance.
